name: CinePlete
description: CinePlete scans your Plex or Jellyfin movie library and shows exactly what you are missing — from franchises, directors, actors, and classics. Includes a dashboard with charts, Radarr/Overseerr/Jellyseerr integration, Letterboxd import, wishlist, ignore system, and smart authentication.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Stores config.yml — persists your settings across updates.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores scan results, TMDB cache, wishlist, and logs.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the CinePlete web interface.
